external_published_reference_models.methodology_note: Direct paid API execution against OpenAI ChatGPT and Google Gemini was not performed in this local offline audit environment. All external values below come strictly from official published documentation and published benchmark reports retrieved on 2026-11-24, clearly separated from direct Jebrex AI local runs.

models_evaluated_published.multimodal_support: Text, vision/image, audio, files, native tools (web search, Python code interpreter)
models_evaluated_published.source: openai.com official announcements & API pricing docs (retrieved 2026-11-24)

models_evaluated_published.context_window_tokens: 400,000+ (long-horizon optimized; exact cap varies by variant)

models_evaluated_published.multimodal_support: Native multimodal, computer use, multi-tool agentic orchestration

models_evaluated_published.release_info: 2025 flagship thinking & long-context model (legacy/transition tier in late 2026)
models_evaluated_published.multimodal_support: Native text, image, audio, video, PDF, code

models_evaluated_published.model_name: Google Gemini 3 Pro / Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
models_evaluated_published.release_info: 2026 flagship native multimodal & agentic reasoning model
models_evaluated_published.multimodal_support: Native unified text, image, dense audio, long video, PDF, code, tool use

non_comparable_dimensions: Native multimodal understanding (vision, audio, long-form video) — supported by GPT-5/6.2 and Gemini 2.5/3, NOT supported by Jebrex AI text-only neural core.
Long-context benchmarks at 200K–1M tokens — Jebrex AI context window is 128–256 UTF-8 bytes (~70–140 Arabic chars or ~40–60 English words).
Agentic computer-use / SWE-bench multi-file repository engineering — requires massive code pretraining and tool-calling RL absent in Jebrex AI neural core.
